items.description: This ultra light version of the Muse 100 combines user-friendly speed with plush comfort and surgical accuracy. Introducing the the lightest member of the Muse family. With this racquet, Yonex puts the plush comfort and easy targeting of the Muse 100 into an even lighter, faster package.

items.name: Yonex Muse 107
items.description: Introducing the most comfortable and powerful member of the Muse family! Introducing the most comfortable and powerful member of the Muse family. At under 10.5 ounces strung, the Muse 107 glides into position with remarkable ease.

items.name: Yonex Muse 98
items.description: Plush. Fast. Accurate Introducing the Muse 98! With this racquet, Yonex delivers an irresistible combination of speed, precision, and comfort. Boasting the most compact head size in the Muse family, this racquet delivers mindless accuracy on full cuts. Offering a light and fast feel, the Muse 98 is very maneuverable, yet delivers surprising stability.

items.name: Yonex Percept 100
items.description: Raw speed. Controllable power. Comfortable feel Introducing the fastest and most intermediate-friendly member of the Percept family! items.name: Yonex Percept 100D Midnight Navy

It also packs a sub-320 swingweight, making it easier to whip up spin from the backcourt or react quickly at net.

items.name: Yonex Percept 97
items.description: Buttery flex. Raw speed. Boasting a zippy sub-320 swingweight, this stick delivers easy spin from the backcourt and swift reactions at the net.

items.name: Yonex Percept 97 Midnight Navy

Boasting a zippy sub-320 swingweight, this stick delivers easy spin from the backcourt and swift reactions at the net.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 100 8th Gen
items.description: This powerful and spin-friendly weapon gets outfitted with a new beam for 2026 Introducing the 8th generation of the VCORE 100! With this 2026 update, Yonex makes incremental changes to the beam while keeping the plush feel, spin-friendly targeting, and easy power for which this model is known.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 100+ 8th Gen
items.description: Updated with a more powerful and aerodynamic beam for 2026! Meet the most powerful member of the VCORE family. It's called the VCORE 100+ 8th Gen, and it combines an extended 27.5" length with a 16x19 string pattern and beefy swingweight. The payoff is a racquet that gives experienced players the ability to hit very powerful, spin-loaded groundies and serves.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 100D 8th Gen
items.description: Yonex adds a new model to the VCORE family for 2026! Meet the 2026 VCORE 100D 8th Gen! With this racquet, Yonex adds a new model to the VCORE family. Defined by its 16x20 string pattern, the 100D adds a more precise and controlled response to the powerful VCORE formula, making it easier to maximize stroke speed when loading the ball with pace and spin.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 100L 8th Gen
items.description: This speedy and spin-friendly weapon gets an impressive makeover for 2026 Meet the VCORE 100L 8th Gen! With this racquet, Yonex brings spin-friendly targeting, plush comfort, and controllable power to the rising intermediate player. Like other members of the VCORE family, this racquet's Isometric head shape has been modified with an even wider contact zone at 10 and 2 o'clock, resulting in a larger spin window and easier access to power.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 95 8th Gen
items.description: Plush and forgiving, this midsize player's racquet gets a more aerodynamic beam for 2026 Meet the 2026 VCORE 95 8th Gen! Defined by its midsize head and 16x20 string pattern, this racquet delivers impressive accuracy on full cuts. It also has a sub-64 RA stiffness, giving it an arm-friendly feel with outstanding ball feedback. Like other members of the VCORE family, the VCORE 95 packs enough spin potential for bringing the ball down sharply.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 98 8th Gen
items.description: This plush and spin-friendly weapon gets a more powerful beam for 2026. Introducing the VCORE 98 8th Gen! Like the previous generation, this racquet combines a 98 square inch head with an open string pattern and Yonex's modified ("Energized") Isometric head shape, which includes an enlarged frame top for a wider spin window and easier access to power.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 98 Tour 8th Gen
items.description: Updated with a faster and more powerful beam construction for 2026 Yonex adds another chapter to the VCORE 98 Tour! Like the previous generation, this racquet combines spin-friendly targeting with a rock solid feel at impact. As the heaviest model in VCORE family, the 98 Tour is more challenging to swing than the standard VCORE 98, but it does a better job absorbing and redirecting the pace of a big hitting opponent.

items.name: Yonex VCORE 98+ 8th Gen
items.description: This powerfully precise weapon gets a new beam and grommet system for 2026 Introducing the VCORE 98+ 8th Gen! Defined by its extended length and 98 square inch head, this racquet gives experienced players a dangerous combination of power and precision. The power comes partly from its 27.5" length, which translates into heavier balls from the baseline and impressive pop on serves.

items.name: TOROLINE A5 16L/1.25 String
items.description: Not all round polys are created equal, including Toroline's A5, which is engineered to help you load the ball with spin. Although it lacks the sharp bite of Toroline's shaped polys, A5 features a low-friction surface to boost snap back and amplify ball rotation. It also packs a moderate stiffness, giving it above-average pop and pocketing for a poly.

items.name: TOROLINE A5 16L/1.25 String Mini Reel - 330'

items.description: Introducing A5 Tour! Boasting six sharp edges for bite and a slippery surface for snapback, this 1.20mm co-poly is a spin monster, making it ideal for those who like adding some arc to their shots (think easy depth). Toroline designed A5 Tour with a custom flex, giving it greater elasticity than the standard A5, making it one of the more comfortable and lively polys in Toroline's lineup.

items.name: TOROLINE Absolute 17/1.20 String
items.description: Boasting a sleek black color, this spin monster shreds the felt with 6 sharp edges. items.name: TOROLINE Cash 16L/1.25 String
items.description: This round monofilament packs above average comfort and pop for a poly. Designed in collaboration with ATP doubles specialist Julian Cash, this round co-poly is made with softening agents to increase comfort while also boosting power, rendering it slightly more responsive on volleys, counterpunches, and slower strokes. It also comes with a slick surface for added snap back and heavier ball rotation, making it a great hybrid partner.

items.name: TOROLINE Caviar 16L/1.24 String Mini Reel - 330'
items.description: This crisp co-poly practically begs you to swing big and target the lines Introducing Caviar 1.24! As one of the most control-oriented strings in Toroline's lineup, this firm co-poly offers an extremely precise and predictable trajectory on full cuts. As such, it lets you swing bigger when loading the ball with pace and spin, while also making it easy to up your risk level.

items.name: TOROLINE Caviar 17/1.20 String Mini Reel - 330'
items.description: Introducing Caviar 17! Like the thicker 16L version, this string's grippy shape and robust 'snapback' make it great for hitting spin-loaded balls that drop hard and explode off the court. What separates it from its thicker sibling is a slight boost in comfort and power. But make no mistake, this is a control-oriented poly that will keep your biggest, most powerful strokes inside the lines.

items.name: TOROLINE DREDDY Hybrid String
items.description: Introducing Dreddy! Made in collaboration with big hitting former tennis pro Dustin Brown, this innovative poly/poly hybrid combines stiffer, hexagonal shaped main strings with slick, softer cross strings. The result is an impressive combination of bite, control, and feel.

items.name: TOROLINE Enso Pro 16L/1.25 String
items.description: Designed with an eye toward comfort and pocketing, this round co-poly packs above average power for the breed. It also features a low-friction surface to enhance snapback and minimize frictional wear. According to Toroline, it is a "super slick string commonly used as a cross string with Wasabi or Toro Toro." It plays more lively than both, making it great for the player looking for easier access to pace.

items.name: TOROLINE K-POP Hybrid String
items.description: This innovative poly/poly hybrid is the string of choice for rising ATP phenom, Karue Sell Designed in collaboration with rising ATP phenom, Karue Sell, K-Pop combines two of Toroline's most popular co-polys: Wasabi and Caviar. In addition to outstanding spin potential, this hybrid offers impressive command over the ball's trajectory and depth.

items.name: TOROLINE K-POP Spin Hybrid String
items.description: This poly/poly hybrid is engineered for spin and comfort Used by ATP Pro Karue Sell, K-Pop Spin builds on the success of the original K-Pop. It combines aggressively shaped pentagonal main strings with slick hexagonal cross strings, resulting in massive spin potential. The lower stiffness level of both the mains and crosses make this one of the most comfortable all-poly setups available at Tennis Warehouse.

items.name: TOROLINE O-SNAP Hybrid String
